title: Shared definitions for regulatory-change-management skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline.

severity_enum.description: Standard four-step severity ladder for impact ratings, gap severities, and risk classifications. Always paired with a free-text rationale field on the consuming object.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by exam-letter ingestion and audit-finding artifacts where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole. Reflects source posture, evidence depth, and how settled the underlying analysis is.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Head of Regulatory Change', 'Head of Reg Affairs', 'CRO', 'General Counsel'). Never an individual person.

source.description: Document, system, person, intake field, named regulatory citation, or '[evidence needed]' when the source is not yet anchored.

evidence_pointer.description: Pointer back to the underlying evidence: file path, system-of-record record ID, source-anchors entry, or sample report ID.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common reg-change gates: legal interpretation sign-off, impact-assessment committee review, implementation-plan approval, exam-brief sign-off.
